text:
Mia: Surprise sticker drop! Left a little stack of ‘Sunshine’ stickers in the kitchen — tiny thank-you for anyone who rescued or cares for office plants lately. If you’ve been the unofficial plant whisperer, help yourself :)
Alex: Wait WHAT — stickers?? :heart_eyes: calling dibs and also nominating @Jamal for the official 'Plant Whisperer' medal.
Jamal: lol thanks but I mostly just remembered to water after the all-hands. Big props to @Priya for bringing fresh soil and to @Olga for fixing the broken saucer.
Priya: Noted! Also planting a tiny basil cutting on Monday so I might need a sticker training session :seedling:
Olga: I patched the saucer and propped the basil up yesterday — happy to take a sticker instead of a medal, but if medals are handed out I will wear it proudly.
Sam: Could we add a low-effort 'Plant Care' badge to the pantry magnet board? Tiny visible wins = good vibes.
Mia: Love that. Quick micro-poll: react :one: for sticker + tiny badge, :two: for sticker + homemade cookie.
stickers-bot: Stickers dispensed: 12 remaining. Sign-up to claim (so we don't run out): https://forms.gle/plant-stickers
Olga: :one: from me. Also FYI the watering rota for next week has Friday open.
Alex: I’ll take Friday. @Mia can you put me on the rota?
Mia: Done — @Alex added. I’ll also leave a handwritten note pack next to the stickers so people can write a one-liner shoutout for their plant hero.
Priya: Can we see the sticker art? curious!
Mia: Here’s the mockup: https://imgur.com/sunshine-sticker.jpg — simple sun + tiny plant.
Jamal: :sparkles: This is such a small thing but it brightens up the week. Thank you, people-ops!
Sam: Also pressing my vote for cookies :cookie: (but I respect the badge movement).
Mia: Cookie option noted — if more folks react :two: I’ll ask for a batch on Friday. Otherwise badges it is. Thanks everyone for keeping our leafy coworkers healthy :)
